message.content: {"verdict":"revise","score":0.72,"reasons":["Artifact only covers CCS and partially CHAdeMO; missing NACS/Tesla, GB/T, and IEC Type 2/Type 1 sections as explicitly requested.","CHAdeMO section is incomplete and ends mid-sentence with abrupt topic shift (ChaoJi) and lacks regional adoption, trend, and transition details.","No clear 3 actionable implications for a fleet buyer are provided; the artifact does not present a final, consolidated, one-page Markdown format as required.","Presentation lacks a complete, uniform Markdown structure across all standards and consolidates sources only vaguely; the result appears fragmentary rather than a finalized single-page reference."],"guidance":"Create a complete, single Markdown file that comprehensively covers CCS1/CCS2, CHAdeMO (including ChaoJi), NACS/Tesla, GB/T, and IEC Type 2/Type 1. For each standard, provide: typical AC and DC power ranges, max charging speeds, regional adoption/regulatory status, vehicle compatibility, common use-cases, installation/equipment cost drivers, interoperability/adapters, major manufacturers/operators, and current market/standardization trends or transition risks. Finish with 3 concise, actionable implications for a fleet buyer (charging uptime, future-proofing, and procurement/installation considerations). Include explicit source links for each standard and present the output as a single Markdown document. Ensure consistency, completeness, and up-to-date details (as of 2026-09) and avoid placeholders; remove any incomplete or speculative sections."}
